title: Source collections
description: The body of the signed POST /v1/source-collections, application/json: one part of the complete listing of the collections the adapter can reach, sent when the source is connected and whenever that set changes. A collection is a place at the source that items are listed from, such as a project, a board or a project on a code host. Collections belong to the organisation the adapter's access key belongs to, keyed on the adapter and the collection's ref. A collection is not active by being listed: it is linked when a person assigns it to a workspace in the control plane, and the adapter learns that from the change feed (changes.schema.json). A complete listing, every part from 1 to n arrived and part n saying complete: true, disconnects, as removed, every collection of the adapter it left out whose last change is older than its started_at. On success the control plane answers a signed 204 with no body. It is signed with the adapter's access key as definitions.schema.json describes. The control plane refuses a time more than 300 seconds from its clock, either way, or a request whose signature it has already seen, with an unsigned 401; definitions.schema.json has the replay rule. A member this schema does not define is refused, invalid_request.

version.description: The document format. The control plane refuses a version it does not read.

time.description: When the adapter built the body, RFC 3339 in UTC with whole seconds. The control plane refuses a time more than 300 seconds from its clock, either way, with an unsigned 401.

collections.description: This part's collections, at most 100. A listing of none, complete, says the adapter reaches no collection.

url.description: The collection's page at the source.

title.description: The collection's name at the source.

target.description: Where a change for the collection's items would go. Absent when the adapter names none.

listing.description: Which part of which listing this is.
